posts.title: Out Drinking and In Trouble
posts.description: Last Friday evening, I was in District 1 (it's the old name, I don't even know the current ward name) with Ruben, Raph, Duy and Hoang. posts.title: The Obvious By-product
posts.description: Xoài got sick after her first week at school. She's having a runny nose with discharging eyes. We asked the doctor and she told us to only clean her noses frequently. One of the positive sides of having a second kid is that you feel less stressed when things happen (again). Besides the apparent discomfort of heavy breathing, she seems to be fine in general. posts.title: Xoài's First Day at School
posts.description: Today was Xoài first day at Kindy City. She woke up early in the morning for some reasons and was really happy to go to school with Bơ. Upon arriving, she didn't even look back and ran to the toy car corner. We left right away, eager to look at the photos that the teachers would share shortly after.
